meta.name: mermaid-skill
meta.description: Generate Mermaid diagrams (.mmd) and export to PNG/SVG/PDF using mmdc CLI or Kroki API. USE THIS SKILL when user mentions diagram, flowchart, sequence diagram, class diagram, ER diagram, state machine, architecture, visualize, git graph, 画图, 架构图, 流程图, 时序图. PROACTIVELY USE when explaining ANY system with 3+ components, API flows, authentication sequences, class hierarchies, database schemas, or state machines. Supports 12+ diagram types with fully automatic layout.

copy.tagline: 用文字描述自动生成专业图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要画流程图、架构图或时序图来沟通技术方案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional diagrams from text descriptions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 Mermaid 图表代码（.mmd 文件），并导出为 PNG、SVG 或 PDF 图片。它支持流程图、时序图、类图等 12 种以上图表类型，自动布局，无需手动调整坐标。
howto.when: 当你提到“图表”、“流程图”、“时序图”、“架构图”等关键词，或要求可视化系统、API 流程、数据库结构时，Claude 会自动使用此技能。

say.text: 画一个 JWT 认证的时序图
say.note: Claude 会生成时序图代码并导出图片。

say.text: 用流程图展示电商微服务架构
say.note: Claude 会生成架构流程图并导出图片。
Claude 会生成状态图并导出图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Mermaid diagram code (.mmd files) based on your description and export them as PNG, SVG, or PDF images. It supports over 12 diagram types including flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, etc., with fully automatic layout.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'diagram', 'flowchart', 'sequence diagram', 'architecture', or ask to visualize a system, API flow, or database schema, Claude will proactively use this skill.

say_en.text: Create a sequence diagram for JWT authentication.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the diagram code and export an image.

say_en.text: Draw a flowchart for e-commerce microservices architecture.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the architecture flowchart and export an image.

say_en.text: Show order lifecycle states as a state diagram.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the state diagram and export an image.
